+## Revalidate complete originals on the actual intake route
+
+A constructor or pure validator test does not establish validation at Store
+intake. Trace its actual callsites, then challenge a previously valid nested
+carrier after construction. Run initial admission and exact replay through both
+the raw Store and facade. Compare full persistent rowsets, dependency reads,
+transaction state and leases on refusal; retain ordinary stage-fence controls.
+Use bounded synthetic typed-input mutations, such as replacing a declared
+endpoint with None or an invalid state, rather than making an arbitrary-Python
+sandbox or Provider-authentication claim.
+
+Reuse the canonical complete-original validator after bounded input accounting
+and current authority/selection, before dependency lookup, serialization, writes
+or duplicate success. Dependency enumeration must not dereference malformed
+convenience properties before that boundary. Never fill an absent original from
+stored rows, translated endpoints or Event coordinates. Keep the original
+clock/provenance/time and full endpoint declaration. Verify with:
+
+```sh
+python -m pytest tests/integration/i6a/test_originals_revalidation.py -q
+```
+
+ORIGINALS-M1 demonstrated constructor/replace refusal alongside actual
+insert/duplicate and explicit-NULL laundering. The corrected source and both
+installed wheel forms refuse those saved counterexamples, while preserving
+normal fences and valid original roundtrips. These are implementation checks;
+non-Author acceptance and release qualification remain separate.
+
+## Require binding provenance after resolving transport
+
+Resolve .json or .json.gz before testing whether a source-binding artifact is
+present. A gzip-aware reader cannot help if an earlier plain-path existence
+predicate skips the reader. Require both complete before/after bindings and
+compare head, tree, input SHA-256 inventory and tracked status. Missing either
+or both is an explicit provenance failure, not evidence of equality. Equal
+missing dictionary values do not prove complete evidence.
+
+```sh
+python -m pytest tests/unit/test_i6a_regression_bindings.py -q
+```
+
+I6A-IR-L01 reproduced consistent=true with null source bindings on the actual
+published compressed evidence. Verify the repaired parser on unchanged archives
+and separately copied compressed mismatch/missing controls. Never rewrite old
+ZIP/JSON evidence to make a new parser pass.
+
+Set UV_CACHE_DIR to a writable external directory in the parent execution
+driver before every uv subprocess, including uv pip install into artifact venvs.
+Setting it only on uv sync leaves later offline installs using a read-only
+home cache. Preserve that setup failure and use a new output directory for the
+corrected execution; compare source and artifact hashes across the retry.

+## Pytest subtest reports are additional measured phases
+
+Pytest 9 unittest `subTest` execution can emit `SubtestReport` call records in

+ordinary-suite journals contained 57 passing subtest reports with repeated parent
+node IDs. The old strict helper correctly refused its once-per-phase predicate;
+that refusal must not be relabeled as strict phase reconciliation or repaired by
+silently deduplicating records.
+
+Keep the original journal, JUnit, starts and failure results. For a new execution,
+capture each actual report class and subtest context in a separate sidecar hook.
+First compare the complete raw journal phase multiset against every sidecar
+report; then separately require exactly one ordinary setup/call/teardown for each
+selected node and retain every subtest outcome. A failing subtest remains fatal,
+even if the final ordinary call reports success. Node-set equality, ordinary
+phase completeness and subtest acceptance are separate facts.
+
+The [I6-A Author evidence](../../../docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6a/author/README.md)
+retains the original discrepancy and external sidecar/reconciliation helpers.
+Its synthetic serial and xdist probes recorded two passing and one intentionally
+failing subtest, preserved all raw reports and rejected subtest acceptance. This
+procedure changes no product test, skip policy or historical receipt and does
+not turn a failing ordinary suite into acceptance.

+## Stage installed test support separately and bind pytest imports
+
+When copied artifact tests import `tests.support`, copy the explicit test package
+root and required support modules into the external harness. A product wheel
+must not acquire a `tests` package to repair a test collection error. Run outside
+the checkout with an explicit minimal pytest configuration: `--confcutdir` alone
+does not prevent pytest from finding an ancestor `pyproject.toml` whose
+`pythonpath = ["src"]` imports the checkout. Keep the offline network guard, but
+never add product source to `PYTHONPATH`.
+
+Check product origins and wheel file hashes inside pytest at session start and
+finish, as well as in the separate runtime probe. Collect first, then reconcile
+the actual selected IDs, JUnit cases and journal starts/phases; a collection error
+or equal passing counts cannot establish execution of the required cohort. Use
+the installed harness helper and its missing-support/shadow-product regression
+controls. Preserve the failed artifact-lane logs separately from corrected runs.
+
+For admission fixture migrations, declare finite identities and permissions at
+fixture composition. Never infer grants from an attempted mutation, expand them
+after refusal, or add an autouse unrestricted issuer. Keep the real product
+transaction owner and commit-held leases. A previous raw `BEGIN`/rollback test
+needs an explicit admission-owned rollback scope, not adoption of an arbitrary
+caller transaction. Verify out-of-grant refusal, unchanged grants and rows,
+revocation after an actual INSERT, rollback, and fixture expiry. File-backed
+admission legitimately creates the catalog writer lock; an exact directory
+assertion should still exclude extra stores while allowing that required lock.

+See the [I6-A remediation evidence](../../../docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6a/remediation-20261023/REPORT.md).

+the newly reached production callsite and its stage; reaching it is not acceptance
+of that stage and does not authorize opening its product route.

+legacy source-only projection separately when comparing signatures. For actual
+assertion reachability, a counterexample-checked line tracer can distinguish a
+setup stop, an entered assertion and an unentered conditional/downstream line.
+Report statement-line entry only; it does not establish assertion subexpression
+coverage or execution in spawned threads/processes. Diagnostic repetitions stay
+separate from the exactly-once ordinary test aggregate.

+## Service-bound Context admission and commit ownership (ADR 0031 I6-A)
+
+Apply this procedure to the I6-A branch's guarded Context API; it is not a grant
+for ordinary Transfer activation or I6-B/C/I7 integration. Both packaged Transfer
+fences remain authoritative. Caller-provided principals, policies and stored
+replay rows do not establish current local authority.
+
+A dependency scan that handles only direct relation objects misses semantically
+reserved carriers. The I6-A supporting review reproduced an OID-only permission
+bypass through `link_core` primitive arguments, and found the same semantic OID
+inside `FieldCandidate("reported_core_reference:...")`. Enumerate typed scope
+Source coordinates and those reserved field values as well as direct
+`CoreReference`, report members, mappings and Disposition replacements. Test each
+public carrier separately, including exact replay after OID-only revocation;
+assert no callback/dependency lookup and no durable row difference. Do not infer a
+local Source registration from an arbitrary provenance `source` string.
+
+Retain a serialized policy lease until the actual outer COMMIT. A SAVEPOINT
+release is not a commit boundary. Checking revision after COMMIT cannot undo
+writes, so validate all live leases before COMMIT and require the trusted port to
+serialize revocation through lease release. An unconnected caller-owned
+coordinator transaction must fail closed until its commit boundary can retain the
+lease. Test a successful first endpoint INSERT followed by a second-INSERT
+trigger failure; preflight rejection does not exercise that rollback. Also test
+actual deferred COMMIT failure followed by explicit ROLLBACK and unchanged
+preexisting Parent/Event evidence. Charge work already performed after failure.
+
+When expanding current mapping candidates or Source positives, bound and charge
+rows before accumulating or decoding the full set. Prefer exact relevant-pair
+lookups over loading a whole Source roster. Current schema inspection must
+preserve lifecycle stop and SQLite CORRUPT/NOTADB exceptions. Reverify connection
+profiles on raw connections, while respecting the existing coordinator's exact
+restricted capabilities, whose factory already verified its connection before
+installing the authorizer. Do not relax that authorizer to execute PRAGMA.
+
+Verified reproductions and limits:
+
+```sh
+pytest -q tests/unit/test_context_admission.py \
+  tests/unit/test_context_fences_i6a.py \
+  tests/unit/test_context_oid_admission_i6a.py \
+  tests/integration/i6a tests/integration/p3/test_transfer_admission.py \
+  tests/integration/p3/test_transfer_sql.py
+```
+
+These are Author regressions and supporting review probes, not independent
+acceptance. See the new [I6-A evidence](../../../docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6a/author/REPORT.md)
+for exact executed source bindings, outcomes and unconnected routes. Never apply
+these procedures by weakening the product's schema fingerprint, SQL constraints,
+fences or original pre-affinity input validation.
+
+For an explicitly authorized paired Context write, the coordinator is the outer
+commit owner. Bind its local service at construction, require its issued
+invocation on admission, and let only the exact expiring transaction capability
+share the commit-owned lease stack with Store/Facade. Accepting a replacement
+service per call would recreate the foreign allow-all attack. Keep Provider and
+Exchange wiring separately refused until their assigned integration stage.
+Exercise the original cross-store/crash/recovery assertions with finite fixture
+authority; a missing context is not proof those assertions executed. The I6-A
+coordinator cohort preserves all original assertion ASTs and runs under this
+explicit binding. Include cursor close and canonical CoverageClaim paths: a
+re-exported domain type's actual `__module__` can differ from the import module,
+so an explicit type/module allowlist must cover the genuine definition without
+an opaque fallback.
+
+## Reserve preparatory work and verify received checksums before normalization
+
+For a finite planner, give its shared hard-cap scanner the remaining cumulative
+request budget before scanning already decoded input. Reserve character passes,
+embedded JSON/identity parsing and queue growth before their allocation or work;
+a later refusal cannot undo a complete preliminary scan. Keep the wire element
+counter distinct from character-inclusive request work. Document the fixed cost
+of a failed reservation and preserve only completed whole semantic units.
+Exercise zero/small/exhausted-prior budgets on large, already validated but
+unselected input; instrument actual parser calls and lengths. Include exact scan
+and full-plan work, depth/byte boundaries and lawful/caller cycles. Output-only
+counters do not establish a bound on preparatory work.
+
+For transport integrity, hash the bounded received dictionary, excluding only
+the declared digest, before constructing a domain type that normalizes sets.
+Reuse the existing canonical encoder and selection `to_dict()` authority. Reject
+received duplicate or noncanonical set arrays even after their raw checksum has
+been recomputed; never silently repair them. Test stale and freshly recomputed
+digests across dictionary/text/UTF-8 carriers, with canonical positive controls.
+A checksum proves neither Provider authenticity nor current admission authority.
+
+Reproduce the Author correction with
+`pytest tests/unit/test_context_scan_budget.py tests/unit/test_exchange_received_digest.py tests/unit/test_context_dependencies.py`.
+The [M01/M02 evidence](../../../docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-m01-m02-20261023/REPORT.md)
+retains the failed frozen review probes and corrected observations. This procedure
+does not activate Provider/Exchange routes, retire Transfer fences or substitute
+for separate non-Author review.

+# ADR 0031 I6 source map, implementation graph and independent review handoff
+
+This is the Design Author's companion to the
+[boundary contract](adr0031-i6-wire-admission-exchange.md) and
+[vectors/test matrix](adr0031-i6-vectors-and-tests.md). The contract specifies
+future behavior; the source observations below describe the effective #132 tree,
+also present in selected base #133. No production edits are made here.
+
+## Findings to requirements
+
+The [I5 independent report](evidence/adr0031-i5/independent/REPORT.md) and
+[findings register](evidence/adr0031-i5/independent/findings.json) are frozen
+evidence, not predictions. A design requirement does not mark a product finding
+fixed. Separate non-Author review and later executable evidence must close it.
+
+| Finding / inherited status | Required design closure | Test/evidence gate |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| I5-A1 Medium, reproduced open boundary | R10–12: mandatory AdmissionContext at public store/facade and every external route; selected Resource/Repository/Source closure and current authorization before existence/replay shortcuts; lease held through commit | T07–10/14/26; deny each dependency separately and deny an exact replay with existing rows and cached receipt |
+| I5-B1 Medium, reproduced open boundary | R08: mandatory complete original ParentReportKey plus original observation payload; no Event-clock/provenance/member synthesis; independent child still admissible | V02–04/V08; T02–04/15/16; original Parent 50/P/51 and Event 100/E/101 |
+| I5-C1 Medium, reproduced open boundary | R09: mandatory pre-filter ProviderEndpointDeclaration and original translated endpoint set; strict equality with received rows; no `endpoints=None` or role synthesis | V04–08; T05/06/14–16; genuine one-sided versus truncated two-sided, including replay/import permutations |
+| I5-D1 Low, independently verified rollback PASS | R15 preserves SAVEPOINT behavior and makes second-INSERT failure mandatory evidence; retain the independent result as historical fact | T17 SQL trace proves first INSERT reached, second failed in-flight, full rollback; separate preflight test remains |
+| I5-F1 Low, facade mitigation verified | R16 requires both-trigger/definition inspection and fail-closed partial/unknown state; retain full schema validation | T19 normal facade, low-level helper and installed packages; not a claim of a code fix in this PR |
+| I4-E1 Low, open evidence-scope carryover | Record full sdist input set separately from runtime/wheel inputs and later evidence publication | T24/25 and exact build/publication inventories; no historical receipt rewrite |
+| Task G G-R1 Medium, I7 carryover | R17 candidate global/scoped reconciliation remains I7-owned | T21–23; no claim of closure from I6 wire preservation |
+
+G3=A is fixed, not an owner question: I8 support is permanently ineligible for an
+I7-native Event; missing eligible I7 report is temporary dependency withholding
+and needs explicit original resupply. Retain all lawful I8 reports independently.

+**R10 — Public API.** Introduce domain/port types with this stable shape (names

+```text

+    -> insert | duplicate | typed refusal
+```

+Every external-input mutation entry point, including generic relation,
+Collection, field, mapping and Source admission used by these routes, requires
+this context. There is **no default unrestricted context**, nullable callback,
+wire-deserialized permission grant or exported "trusted=True" switch. The
+composition root supplies a local authorization port; a missing context or
+unsupported policy implementation fails closed before duplicate lookup/writes.
+The store/facade is bound at construction to the trusted local policy service;
+it verifies that the context's policy handle belongs to that service. A caller
+cannot supply a replacement allow-all authorizer or self-assert another
+principal. The principal comes from the local authenticated invocation/session
+boundary, never a Provider field, package, claimed issuer or Source UUID.
+An internal structural writer may be private behind this boundary but is not an
+alternative public untrusted route. Disposable tests inject an explicit test
+authorizer; production does not infer trust from stack frames or Python type
+names. The raw SQLite handle is trusted infrastructure, outside caller-facing
+authorization; its structural constraints still apply. SQL alone cannot enforce
+principal permissions.

+Selection uses the existing four seed dimensions; omitted selection is rejected
+unless an explicit local `all_selected` request exists. Empty sets select none.
+Sender selection metadata describes its export, never authorizes the receiver.
+Receiver intersects it with its own requested bounded closure and current local
+permission scope. A service registration grants no Resource access. Parent/member
+dependencies enter the effective selection only through the explicit bounded
+dependency policy; no namespace traversal, all-Provider expansion or permission
+expansion. Resources need an independent Resource grant; Repository permission
+alone is not authority for unrelated globally identified Resources. Source grants
+are separately checked and cannot be inferred from a claimed provenance string.
+
+**R11 — DependencySet and current checks.** Enumerate every referenced Resource
+(Event, native I7 coordinate as a Resource dependency for Transfer only, reported
+Parent, every report/member, both Provider repositories, support subjects), every
+Core Repository target, every provenance Source registration, relevant known
+positive Source–Repository association, complete MappingClaimKeys and referenced
+Disposition/replacement claims. Parent/member presence in SQL never grants access.
+Where provenance identifies an external attributed issuer without a local Source
+registration, preserve the allowed external claim and its omission/NULL state;
+never invent a Source. Any actual Source reference must resolve and be authorized.
+
+Before admission **and exact replay**, under the same operation snapshot, check
+effective selection, current permission for every dependency, original native and
+event semantics, full Parent key/time, selected members, Source service/known
+positives, mapping support and current qualified evaluation (including any
+operation-scoped Disposition evidence). Reusing the original mapping payload is
+required; recalculation must not mint a new Event provenance or bind a different
+target. Existing rows, sender flags and the digest are insufficient. A receiver
+may preserve lawful attributed reports without claiming authenticated Provider
+origin. Normalized event type/native-contract checks and current operation
+evidence are distinct from structural FK existence and origin authentication.
+
+The authorizer issues a short-lived local policy revision/lease held through
+commit. Revocation before commit invalidates the lease and rolls back; acquisition
+must not hold a DB write transaction over network calls. Read dependencies in a
+consistent snapshot, acquire the normal writer lock, and recheck snapshot/policy
+revision and qualification inside the write unit. Restart bounded validation on
+revision drift, charging actual work. Never cache a grant in a report or durable
+"verified" column. A prior accepted unit can remain historical evidence after
+revocation, while replay/export/current effective use still requires fresh checks.
+

+fallback. For syntactically valid identifiers, perform authorization before local
+existence lookups; do not reveal denied dependency contents/existence. Use:
+
+| Code | Meaning / allowed next action |
+| --- | --- |
+| `PERMISSION_DENIED` | Local policy refuses a dependency or operation. Zero unit writes; no existence-sensitive details. New authorization and explicit resubmission required. |
+| `OMITTED_BY_SELECTION` | Needed part outside effective selection. Withhold whole dependent unit; selecting it later still requires explicit resubmission. |
+| `MISSING_DEPENDENCY` | Authorized selected exact dependency unavailable. No fabrication; original resupply after arrival. |
+| `UNQUALIFIED_MAPPING` | Supplied mapping support fails current operation qualification; preserve independent lawful reports, no resolved effect or substitution. |
+| `QS10_PARENT_INELIGIBLE` | Reported I8 differs from E's native I7; permanent for this support. Retain lawful I8 Parent report separately. |
+| `INCOMPLETE_ORIGINAL_REPORT` / `INCOMPLETE_ENDPOINT_SET` | Original coordinates/declaration or received endpoint set incomplete. No conversion to one-sided. |
+| `INPUT_LIMIT` | Actual finite limit stop; preserve completed independent units and charge work. |
+| `IMMUTABLE_REPLAY_CONFLICT` | Same immutable key, changed payload/time. Reject changed unit; never patch or choose a winner. |
+
+For multiple applicable outcomes, syntax first, then authorization denial, then
+selection omission, then permanent semantic/type violation, then missing or
+unqualified dependencies, then replay comparison. No DB-dependent diagnostic
+precedes authorization. Ordinary untrusted bad input is not itself stored
+corruption. A proven invalid retained authoritative row invokes Recovery Stop.
+
+## 6. Closure, ordering, replay and transactions
+
+**R13 — Closure.** From a consistent snapshot, start only with explicit seeds.
+Enumerate actual common report/member, Collection, Source/proof and typed mapping
+dependencies. Resource registration needs Provider registration plus complete
+identification, **not a namespace/Parent Resource/report**. Parent relations need
+their actual referents. Transfer needs its exact Parent report and Event, declared
+Provider roles/endpoints, mappings and Source supports. Collection/proof units
+need all original members/terminal alternatives required by their scope. Do not
+traverse identifiers to infer a Parent. Visit each semantic dependency once for
+closure; charge all actual checks and cap edges/work as well as nodes/depth.
+Cycles stop via visited sets. No topological-sort requirement may reject a
+lawful cyclic generic graph: register independent Resources first, then whole
+reports. Cyclic impossible support dependencies are withheld with diagnostics.
+
+Sender closure can add permitted dependencies only under the requested policy;
+receiver computes its own closure and does not trust sender reports. If a member,
+Source, target, support or real terminal is missing/denied/unselected/over-limit,
+withhold that whole atomic unit and associated completeness, not just the member.
+Selected, authorized, validated local dependencies may satisfy receiver closure;
+their mere existence is insufficient. Sender must itself validate the full unit
+before emitting it. Diagnostics use bounded codes and authorized coordinates,
+never full unadmitted original payloads. No durable pending original-bearing jobs.
+
+**R14 — Admission order and replay.** Validate whole package envelopes/digest
+before mutation; plan independent units in memory. Admit registrations and all
+complete Resource identities without Parent ordering, then Source positives,
+mapping claims/Dispositions, generic and Parent reports, then whole Transfer
+units, then genuine terminals/proofs/Coverage. Validate and admit within snapshot
+and authorization fences. This corrects the current Transfer-before-Parent import
+order. Each unit is transactional; a withheld unit does not invalidate independent
+child identity. Malformed envelope/digest yields no package writes.
+
+PackageKey binding/checkpoints remain Operational only, using Q-E7–E10's current
+precommit and loss rules. Package replay must re-evaluate current selection,
+permission and eligibility before any cached success; receipt existence is not
+admission authority. Same PackageKey with changed content is refused. Exact
+accepted report replay is `duplicate` only after all current checks, with no new
+observation time/provenance. A previously refused unit is never auto-replayed on
+Parent/mapping arrival, reopen, checkpoint resume or reverse Exchange. Explicit
+resupply preserves originals. A changed filtered package needs a new PackageKey;
+reversing/onward forwarding preserves the original report keys, not the relay's
+clock. An originally unresolved Provider role cannot be silently rewritten in the
+same immutable EventReportKey when a mapping arrives; explicit original resupply
+may only add support through a separately justified genuine domain observation,
+never a fabricated new clock/provenance or amendment of the old report.
+
+**R15 — SQL and rollback.** Keep I4's complete ParentReport FK, native-I7 typed
+Resource FK/UNIQUE, endpoint-to-complete-EventReport FK, BINARY comparisons,
+mandatory projections, row-local bounded deterministic UDFs, pre-conflict guards
+and immutable originals. Do not weaken them to satisfy new wire cases. Validate
+original timestamp/input types before SQLite affinity: strict int 1..int64-max or
+NULL for nullable observations/Provider times; required Coverage/terminal times
+are positive non-NULL; native Git times retain their signed contract. Reject
+bool/float/numeric strings and missing required fields before binding.
+Transfer Event clock `at_us` remains a required positive integer as in I5;
+nullable clocks on other lawful report types retain their separate contracts.
+
+The writer uses `SAVEPOINT p1_transfer_event` around Event report and **all**
+endpoint INSERTs, validates complete rows after writing, and rolls back on any
+constraint, policy-revision, postcondition, release or outer COMMIT failure.
+Never catch an endpoint failure and return partial success. Dependencies admitted
+as independent earlier units need not roll back, but no partial Transfer row or
+mutated preexisting original may survive. Keep required FK/CHECK/recursive-trigger
+settings and verified schema/UDF registrations on every supported connection.
+Arbitrary direct SQL is not claimed to provide authorization, original input-type
+validation or whole-unit endpoint atomicity. The in-flight second-INSERT test is
+mandatory; a preflight refusal does not test SAVEPOINT rollback.
+
+**R16 — Fence state.** I6-A replaces asymmetric `has_transfer_fence()` inspection
+with a full expected-state check: both expected definitions present = staged;
+only one/malformed/uninspectable = unsupported schema/fail closed; neither is
+permitted only in explicitly isolated synthetic fixtures, or the later reviewed
+integrated schema that retires them. Ordinary schema validation remains mandatory.
+No helper result may enable Transfer when one fence is missing. I6-A/B/C retain
+both packaged SQL triggers and normal application refusals. Identification wire
+refusal can retire for reviewed non-Transfer v5 routes in I6-B/C; that does not
+retire any Transfer fence.
+
+## 7. I7, I8 and final gate
+
+**R17 — Recovery.** I7 owns enduring stored validation, Task G G-R1 candidate
+global/scoped exposure, schema/FK/UDF/trigger tampering checks, pairing and
+backup/recovery. Decode with trusted code without executing recovered schema.
+Reconstruct explicit complete original reports and all endpoint references;
+recheck native-I7 and full support, actual terminals, Source positives and
+Coverage. `foreign_key_check` alone is insufficient. Keep lawful I8 Parent
+reports without using them as Transfer support. Proven retained-data corruption
+stops ordinary reads/writes/export/Search/normal backups immediately under ADR
+0026; preserve source read only, salvage as untrusted candidates, restore fresh
+paired Core+Context with separate Access scope, validate merge before activation.
+Salvage intake uses the same mandatory authorization boundary and current policy;
+no sender/stored flags authorize recovery or hidden replays. Historical retained
+evidence and current qualified effectiveness are separate; policy revocation
+alone is not corruption or permission to delete a report.
+
+**R18 — Query.** I8 owns semantic Parent querying separately from identifier
+namespace filters, generic unknown/global/scoped/non-leaf reads, Transfer summary
+and Source/Coverage/conflict projection, Search/fallback/rebuild agreement and
+generation/snapshot fences. It must not infer Parent by ID, select a report
+winner, use ineligible I8 support, or treat Provider-only endpoints as resolved.
+Stored rows/Search flags cannot bypass current qualified interpretation or caller
+permission. Basic generic reads may follow I6-B; Transfer query acceptance waits
+for I7 and integrated tests. No arbitrary structured Search promise is added.
+
+**R19 — Retirement prerequisite.** A separately authorized integrated PR may
+remove both SQL fences and ordinary Transfer refusals only after non-Author
+acceptance of frozen I6-A/B/C, I7 and I8 inputs, end-to-end permission/selection
+and recovery/query routes, both distribution forms outside checkout, all SQL
+adversarial cases, and honest full regression reconciliation. Update DDL/UDF
+checks/fingerprints and every normal route together; no piecemeal trigger drop,
+runtime flag or private production bypass. This design PR authorizes no such
+retirement, merge, deployment, release, P8 or real Provider/catalog operation.
+
+All new executions follow [ADR 0032](../adr/0032-environment-sqlite-validation.md):
+the selected environment Python's actual SQLite only, measured identities and
+unchanged product safety/capability floors. No additional test SQLite engines,
+version matrix or loader replacement. Historical two-engine receipts are facts,
+not instructions. Design test vectors are specifications, not executed results.

+# ADR 0031 I6-B: generalized v5 wire and finite dependency plans
+
+This implementation follows the accepted [I6 boundary contract](adr0031-i6-wire-admission-exchange.md)
+and [stage allocation](adr0031-i6-change-map-and-handoff.md). It is directly
+stacked on independent I6-A review #149, frozen at
+`ea43a21fca1dbf8fa6dd1c254b28a96d5dd28d00`, tree
+`e7ca7e361b8b766f1976a12fc84d5cc50ac32232`. That review's scoped PASS closes
+ORIGINALS-M1 and I6A-IR-L01; its historical execution evidence is unchanged.
+
+## Public pure interfaces
+
+- `exchange.decode_package` / `encode_package` implement only
+  `git-repo-db/adr0031-exchange-v5`. They validate the exact envelope and row
+  profiles, canonical Resource identities, strict JSON values and canonical-data
+  SHA-256. A parsed package is still untrusted input, requiring typed semantic,
+  dependency, selection and current authority checks before admission.
+- `ResourceIdentification.to_wire` / `from_wire` preserve all seven named
+  Resource columns through the existing identity/identification authority.
+  Namespace coordinates register no Parent and create no traversal edge.
+- `context_wire.decode_context_v5` / `encode_context_v5` validate a whole Context
+  section using those row profiles and the existing typed Context validators.
+  The section API has an explicit v5 name; untrusted complete packages first
+  require the envelope API to check their version and digest.
+- `context_dependencies.plan_context_dependencies` creates an in-memory finite
+  selection plan of whole original semantic units and typed omissions. It never
+  issues authorization or stores withheld reports. `prior_work` carries actual
+  work already spent within the same explicit request; retries must retain it.
+
+Malformed known contracts have no global/opaque fallback. Parent originals are
+looked up only by their complete original key; their time is read from that exact
+Parent row. Endpoint declarations and full Event references survive unchanged.
+No Event clock, provenance, endpoint row subset or transport completion supplies
+missing original evidence.
+
+Relation and Collection member order remains significant. Real terminal
+alternatives, Source set inventories and Coverage proofs retain their original
+coordinates and states. Withholding a required member or terminal alternative
+withholds its whole unit and dependent completeness; it never shrinks a complete
+report or manufactures an empty terminal. Resource registrations remain
+independent of their semantic reports, including lawful cyclic graphs.
+
+## Scope and remaining integration
+
+I6-C owns Provider normalization, application export/import, receiver-local
+selection/authorization composition and replay. I7 owns stored/recovery
+revalidation and pairing; I8 owns query/Search consumption. Both exact Transfer
+SQL fences and the existing service-bound AdmissionContext/current checks remain
+mandatory. The ordinary unwired routes remain fail closed. The new pure codec
+and planner confer no operational capability and do not activate Transfer.
+
+The Author team validates this implementation; this is not the separate
+non-Author I6-B review. The parent will request that later review after verifying
+the submitted PR and HEAD. No next stage is started here.
+
+See the [new Author evidence](evidence/adr0031-i6b-author-20261023/README.md),
+[requirement/test matrix](evidence/adr0031-i6b-author-20261023/MATRIX.md), and its
+run-specific source, command, exit, JUnit/journal and distribution bindings.
+Development CI Success is limited to its selected checks; complete Release
+acceptance requires separate independent local and hosted validation and is not
+claimed by this stage.

+## Findings and design closure of I5 boundaries
+
+### I5-A1 — caller authorization
+
+**Closed at design level, open at product level.** R10 binds the facade/store to
+its trusted local policy service and authenticated invocation principal; callers
+cannot select a different allow-all implementation. Resource, Repository, Source,
+claim and replacement permissions differ from selection. R11 checks the full
+DependencySet before duplicate success, including locally existing rows. R14 also
+puts cached package success behind current checks. R11's lease and writer-lock
+recheck explicitly cover revocation between check and commit; actual work on
+bounded restart is charged. This requires a real policy transaction/lease adapter,
+not just a boolean permission callback.
+
+The independent B-A1 probe shows the current store still has no `admission`
+parameter, inserts a complete report without any local policy and returns
+`duplicate` on replay. That is baseline reproduction, not a new bypass through
+normal product fences. T07–09/14/26 supply the main future negative controls.
+The nonblocking finding I6-L1 below makes policy-handle/principal forgery explicit.
+
+### I5-B1 — independent original Parent evidence
+
+**Closed at design level, open at product level.** R08 requires the exact seven
+SQL key coordinates and genuine independent original time; a complete Parent row
+can come from the package or authorized validated local storage. It never borrows
+Event clock/provenance/time or chooses another Parent. Missing coordinates and
+missing exact rows have different outcomes. Child identity remains independently
+admissible. R01/R08/R15 retain the additional native-I7 typed constraint without
+turning namespace coordinates into a Parent report. Lawful I8 reports survive,
+but never qualify an I7-native Transfer. T02–04/15/16 cover alternatives/resupply.
+
+B-B1 independently registers the child before I7, stores Parent 50/P/51 and Event
+100/E/101, reproduces the old constructor's false missing-dependency failure,
+and then admits with the explicit original Parent key. The independent Parent
+time remains 51. Current constructors still synthesize defaults; future mandatory
+carriers must make that construction impossible and compare original time.
+
+### I5-C1 — original Provider endpoint declaration
+
+**Closed at design level, open at product level.** R09 requires declaration before
+filtering and exact received endpoint comparison, using the existing nine-key
+scope rather than a duplicate authority. Genuine `not_reported`, explicit NULL,
+Provider-only unresolved, resolved, missing and filtered states remain distinct.
+Full declarations cannot be rescued by previously stored endpoint rows. R14
+preserves immutable Event keys across reverse/onward/repeat delivery; later mapping
+arrival cannot amend the old unresolved report or fabricate a new observation.
+A coherently forged first unsigned report remains unauthenticated, as ADRs
+0027/0028/0030 require; checksum correction cannot authenticate it.
+
+B-C1 constructs an original two-sided synthetic report, drops a role before old
+constructor invocation and confirms the baseline admits the surviving one-sided
+report. R09/V05/T05 must reject that loss when the original declaration is carried.
+This test deliberately uses a separate disposable fixture; it is not replay of a
+changed payload under an already admitted original key.
+
+### I6-L1 — enumerate local policy-handle and principal substitution tests
+
+Severity **Low**, nonblocking test-plan gap; R10 contract itself is sufficient.
+Targets R10/R11, V08 (sender permission is not local authority), T07/T08/T26.
+See [findings.json](findings.json) for complete machine-readable fields.
+
+R10 lines 296–305 requires service-bound policy handles and locally established
+principals. T07 tests denied dependencies and T26 injects a deny-all trusted
+policy, but neither explicitly calls the API with a context from another policy
+service or a caller-chosen privileged principal. A buggy future implementation
+could pass those tests while trusting `admission.authorizer` or `principal` from
+the caller. Add both negative cases to T07/T26: foreign allow-all policy handle
+and forged principal must fail before lookup/write, on initial admission and
+exact replay; instrument the trusted service to show the substituted service
+was not used. The wire sender field case is separate from direct API injection.
+No production counterexample is claimed: AdmissionContext does not exist yet.
+
+Required change: enumerate those cases in the implementation's R10 test mapping;
+no accepted ADR or substantive contract change is needed. Re-review at frozen
+I6-A with actual typed refusal, zero row delta, no existence leakage and exact
+replay denial. This can be delivered in A; it does not require modifying #134.
+
+## Wire, identity, finite closure and evidence semantics
+
+R02 names exact v5 and inherits a pinned finite grammar, changing only seven
+Resource columns and the two endpoint report references. R03 explicitly preserves
+the existing ASCII Context JSON profile versus UTF-8 outer digest profile.
+`resource_identity.encode_identity`/`parse_identity` remain the only identity
+codec; there is no second wire implementation authority. R05 matches the current
+four-column `ResourceIdentification` validator, including global Document repeated
+ID, canonical namespace-TEXT and explicit known-contract dispatch. Known malformed
+input cannot retry as opaque; unknown kinds have bounded common semantics.
+
+R06 preserves ordered whole relation and Collection reports, not sorted/unioned
+members. R07 correctly distinguishes sorted Source inventory, positive association
+retention, real terminal alternatives and the existing five Coverage columns.
+A late partial or withheld terminal cannot borrow prior completeness. R13 handles
+finite node/edge/depth/byte/work bounds and visited sets; lawful generic cycles
+register identities first and reports second. There is no native Parent walk or
+Provider-wide permission expansion. R14 fixes current import's Parent-first
+resource loop and Transfer-before-Parent order while preserving explicit resupply.
+
+Our 15 wire/domain checks exercise existing canonical identity, identification,
+ordered relations, terminal distinctions and sorted inventory. **No v5 codec,
+new closure planner, new authorization adapter or future T01–T27 suite was run.**
+
+## SQL, transaction and Recovery review
+
+Current `p1_ddl/context.sql:134` retains two distinct references: full original
+Parent report and native-I7 Resource/typed uniqueness. `context.sql:372` ties each
+endpoint to the complete Event report. Existing immutable/pre-conflict guards and
+row-local deterministic UDFs must remain; SQL does not authenticate callers or
+prove whole endpoint receipt by itself.
+
+R15/T17–18 correctly separate preflight, in-flight second INSERT and deferred
+COMMIT failure. B-D1's injected second-endpoint trigger observes **one Event and
+one endpoint already present**, then fails with `SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_TRIGGER`;
+trace shows `ROLLBACK TO p1_transfer_event`, resulting counts **0/0** and unchanged
+Parent original. This confirms the existing SAVEPOINT behavior, not future policy
+rollback. The independent raw SQL deferred-FK probe shows why explicit outer
+rollback matters: COMMIT returns `SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY` while transaction
+and pending counts **1/1** remain; explicit ROLLBACK restores **0/0**. Merely catching
+the COMMIT exception is insufficient. R15 already requires this rollback.
+
+Five fence-state probes reproduce the asymmetric current `has_transfer_fence`;
+exact composed schema comparison detects each modified definition/missing fence.
+The current facade even accepts the exact two-fence-removed synthetic schema
+shape (`production_context.py:350`); this is **not** evidence that normal reopen
+is already safe. R16/T19 explicitly require normal reopen refusal and trusted
+fixture separation. Both packaged fence definitions remain byte-identical here.
+The B-STAGE probe confirms normal store refusal with both present and zero writes.
+
+R17/T20–22 properly require trusted reconstruction, all original endpoint refs,
+native support, real terminals, Source/Coverage, source Stop and fresh paired
+restore; clean FK checks alone do not qualify recovery. Current-policy revocation
+alone is not stored corruption. IO/lock/budget uncertainty must not become a
+fabricated corruption verdict. G-R1 remains I7 work. R18 keeps namespace filters
+separate from semantic Parent and effective qualified Transfer/Search; R19 holds
+both fences until reviewed C/I7/I8 and final integrated/distribution acceptance.
+
+## Implementation entry and acceptance conditions
+
+- **I6-A may start** from this reviewed design with existing I4/I5 ancestry.
+  Introduce immutable mandatory originals/declaration and trusted AdmissionContext
+  at store/facade; make every external callsite lacking context refuse before
+  writes. Preserve both fences and native/full-report SQL; extend T07/T26 for
+  I6-L1. Accept A only after independent A1/B1/C1 negative probes, revocation races,
+  replay, real SQL rollback/COMMIT, complete fence states and installed-artifact
+  checks. Normal route positives remain staged. Do not create temporary permissive
+  contexts to keep old application callsites working.
+- **I6-B starts after frozen non-Author A review.** Reuse existing identity codec,
+  add pure exact bounded v5 codec/planner and whole terminal/Source/Coverage rules;
+  normal unwired routes and Transfer remain refused. Independently test malformed
+  versions/keys/duplicates, cap boundaries, cycles, seven-column roundtrips and
+  full originals. A pure codec is not a permission grant.
+- **I6-C starts after frozen non-Author B review.** Carry genuine Provider originals
+  and declarations before filtering; connect all external routes/composition roots
+  to the same guarded API, remove the legacy native-Parent registration loop and
+  re-evaluate cached package replay. Demonstrate explicit isolated sender→wire→
+  receiver roundtrips and normal Transfer refusal; audit every callsite.
+- **I7** depends on reviewed durable A/B/C forms, trusted decoding, G-R1, Stop,
+  pairing, untrusted authorized salvage and fresh activation. **I8** basic generic
+  reads can follow B; Transfer interpretation waits for C/I7 and scan/Search parity.
+  A later separately authorized integrated retirement must reconcile all inherited
+  failure nodes and both installed distribution forms, then change both fences
+  and application guards together. This review authorizes none of that retirement.
+

+# ADR 0031 I6 source map, implementation graph and independent review handoff
+
+This is the Design Author's companion to the
+[boundary contract](adr0031-i6-wire-admission-exchange.md) and
+[vectors/test matrix](adr0031-i6-vectors-and-tests.md). The contract specifies
+future behavior; the source observations below describe the effective #132 tree,
+also present in selected base #133. No production edits are made here.
+
+## Findings to requirements
+
+The [I5 independent report](evidence/adr0031-i5/independent/REPORT.md) and
+[findings register](evidence/adr0031-i5/independent/findings.json) are frozen
+evidence, not predictions. A design requirement does not mark a product finding
+fixed. Separate non-Author review and later executable evidence must close it.
+
+| Finding / inherited status | Required design closure | Test/evidence gate |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| I5-A1 Medium, reproduced open boundary | R10–12: mandatory AdmissionContext at public store/facade and every external route; selected Resource/Repository/Source closure and current authorization before existence/replay shortcuts; lease held through commit | T07–10/14/26; deny each dependency separately and deny an exact replay with existing rows and cached receipt |
+| I5-B1 Medium, reproduced open boundary | R08: mandatory complete original ParentReportKey plus original observation payload; no Event-clock/provenance/member synthesis; independent child still admissible | V02–04/V08; T02–04/15/16; original Parent 50/P/51 and Event 100/E/101 |
+| I5-C1 Medium, reproduced open boundary | R09: mandatory pre-filter ProviderEndpointDeclaration and original translated endpoint set; strict equality with received rows; no `endpoints=None` or role synthesis | V04–08; T05/06/14–16; genuine one-sided versus truncated two-sided, including replay/import permutations |
+| I5-D1 Low, independently verified rollback PASS | R15 preserves SAVEPOINT behavior and makes second-INSERT failure mandatory evidence; retain the independent result as historical fact | T17 SQL trace proves first INSERT reached, second failed in-flight, full rollback; separate preflight test remains |
+| I5-F1 Low, facade mitigation verified | R16 requires both-trigger/definition inspection and fail-closed partial/unknown state; retain full schema validation | T19 normal facade, low-level helper and installed packages; not a claim of a code fix in this PR |
+| I4-E1 Low, open evidence-scope carryover | Record full sdist input set separately from runtime/wheel inputs and later evidence publication | T24/25 and exact build/publication inventories; no historical receipt rewrite |
+| Task G G-R1 Medium, I7 carryover | R17 candidate global/scoped reconciliation remains I7-owned | T21–23; no claim of closure from I6 wire preservation |
+
+G3=A is fixed, not an owner question: I8 support is permanently ineligible for an
+I7-native Event; missing eligible I7 report is temporary dependency withholding
+and needs explicit original resupply. Retain all lawful I8 reports independently.
+
+## Source-level investigation and intended changes
+
+Anchors are line numbers at #133 `f16e5b1` / unchanged product files from #132
+`a022dd3`. Later implementers must search symbols again after edits. Paths in this
+table are relative to `src/repo_catalog/`. These are proposed edits only.
+
+| File / symbols | Observed behavior → required change / owner |
+| --- | --- |
+| `domain/resource_identity.py:29,81,118,165` | Already strict bounded canonical identity codec. Reuse its exact string/list grammar, scanner, escaped byte and node limits; no competing wire encoder or common coercion. I6-B adds roundtrip/cap tests, not a new identity authority. |
+| `domain/resource_identification.py:30,59,125` | Explicit four-column declaration already separates namespace from report existence and revalidates duplicates. Add exact named-field v5 encode/decode using this validator. Preserve global-document repetition and known namespace dispatch; no array-shape inference. I6-B. |
+| `domain/p1_context.py:783,1723,1753–2145` | FieldClock, EventReportKey, TransferEventReport, `__post_init__`, `from_targets`, `from_stored_scope` and `provided_roles`: optional Parent fields currently borrow Event originals; endpoint/role defaults derive from surviving relations. I6-A makes original Parent/key/time and declaration mandatory; creates an explicitly non-admissible incomplete type if needed. Remove every synthesis/replay bypass, preserve independent clocks and complete endpoint references. |
+| `domain/parent_report.py:30,69` | Existing direct ParentReportKey is the basis, not a new identity. Add a complete immutable Parent observation carrier/lookup result binding its own original time. Keep existing seven PK components and singleton typed constraints. I6-A. |
+| `domain/transfer_sql.py:21,103` | Existing bounded Event and endpoint predicates enforce the exact nine-key scope, Parent support and role/member consistency. Reuse and, if needed, tighten canonical declaration-order checks without weakening native-I7 SQL, complete reference FKs or stage fences. I6-A. |

I6-B requires exact v5 fields and explicit declaration/original Parent; missing references cannot be filled from rows. |

Add Resource/Source/claim policy checks and bounded dependency plan shared by sender/receiver; preserve original declarations/terminals and whole-unit withholding. Namespace is already excluded from expansion: preserve that. I6-B/C. |
+| `domain/selective_exchange.py:657–674` `preflight_i2_resources/context` | Blanket refusal for review/thread/comment/document because v4 lacks identification. Replace with exact v5 identification validation; do not merely delete guards or treat arbitrary keys as declarations. Transfer operation refusal remains until integrated retirement. I6-B/C. |
+| `domain/selective_exchange.py:674,791` `validate_context/bindings` | Resources currently validate only key triples. Known plural child groups compare `scoped_document_coordinates()` with owner. Decode explicit identification once; distinguish named known ownership semantics from general semantic Parent. No global Document scoped-parser fallback or Parent existence check for identity registration. I6-B. |
+| `domain/selective_exchange.py:887,1083,1184` | `bound_sections`, proof/terminal validation and Coverage preservation already protect whole dependencies and real terminals. Extend semantic units to explicit original Parent/report/endpoint dependencies and current grants; count actual work, preserve withheld terminal alternatives and honest limit stops. I6-B/C. |
+| `domain/exchange.py:27,162,233,418,478` | v4 FORMAT, outer caps/digest, selection scope, package grammar. I6-B versions to exact v5, retains outer canonical profile and PackageKey semantics, rejects unknown/missing version, preserves domain-only registrations and strict selection primitive types (no bool/int coercion in decoder). |
+| `domain/exchange_rows.py:7,304,482` | v4 ROW_KEYS omit four identifying columns and endpoint full-report refs. Add exact v5 profiles; validate types/unknown fields before reconstruction, preserve replay scope/time checks. Do not use a digest as a domain key. I6-B. |
+| `adapters/sqlite/p1_context.py:127,152,333` | Resource registration already has explicit identification and no Parent registration walk. `admit_transfer_event` has structural checks/SAVEPOINT but no caller context/current grant checks and compares endpoint sets after optional synthesis. I6-A requires AdmissionContext, full original key/time/declaration and qualified dependency checks before duplicate shortcut. Preserve in-flight rollback and I4 SQL. |
+| `adapters/sqlite/production_context.py:482,521,568,583,596,676,898` | Resource, inheritance, `_members`, `_parent_dependencies`, relation/Collection facade and Transfer facade. Relation permits unrestricted `None` policy; Transfer has no permission context. Untrusted paths must require context; common writer cannot be selected as a bypass. Preserve known child collection semantics and independently validated semantic Parent referents. Add tests for a global Document owning children. I6-A/B/C. |
+| `application/acquisition.py:1185,1210,1278,1420,1440,1463,1476` | `_ensure_resource_hierarchy` no longer walks native Parent but can fetch existing identification; `_register_reference` also uses stored declaration for known kinds. Require supplied declaration for newly referenced Resources, or authorized validated existing declaration; never infer/register namespace Parent. `_preflight_units` refuses Transfer. `_admit_transfer_unit` derives roles, mappings and report, then may substitute a prior report by clock/provenance. I6-C passes mandatory originals/declaration/context, verifies actual event semantics, rechecks prior originals and qualified mapping before replay, removes permissive fallback. Stage refusal stays. |
+| `application/exchange.py:1157–1208` | Export reads only three Resource columns and eight endpoint fields before blanket identification refusal. Read all seven Resource columns and both endpoint references; preserve originals before filtering/limits. I6-C. |
+| `application/exchange.py:1470–1750,2065–2490` | Import accepts Repository permissions, filters then dependency pass reads broad existing rows. I6-C supplies receiver-local Resource/Source/claim authority; scope authorized local lookups and accounting. Package receipt shortcut cannot bypass current permission/eligibility. No denied-row existence disclosure. |
+| `application/exchange.py:2299–2326` `_context_dependencies` | **Legacy registration prerequisite:** scoped kinds derive native Parent from ID and wait until it exists, reporting `missing_parent_or_provider`. Remove native Parent dependency/loop; require Provider registration plus explicit complete identification only. Parent report and Transfer units separately require real referents. I6-C. |
+| `application/exchange.py:2990–3090,3200+` `_import_context_into` | **Legacy parent-first resource sorting**, `ctx.resource(rk)` drops identification; Transfer admitted before generic/Parent reports. Replace registration sort with independent Resources carrying declarations; admit Parent/mapping support before whole Transfer; shared guarded API for every unit. I6-C. |
+| `application/production_query.py:1050,1190` | Resource views already expose identifier namespace separately; semantic `parent` list filter still refuses, `transfer_summary` is absent in inherited failures. I8 adds semantic Parent views and Transfer integration without identifier inference or winner selection. I6 only supplies stable codec/contract. |
+| `adapters/sqlite/recovery_validation.py:63,79,172,219` | Reconstructs identifications and Parent reports; endpoint SELECT/reconstruction omits the two complete Event reference fields, staged storage refuses Transfer. I7 reads complete durable forms, trusted validators and full keys/declared endpoint equality, preserving Recovery Stop. I6-A exports shared pure validation interface; no premature normal recovery acceptance. |
+
+### Namespace and Parent assumptions: remove versus retain
+
+The source scan covered the named files plus `domain/parent_report.py`,
+`domain/production_context.py`, `domain/context_registration.py` and every
+`scoped_document_coordinates` / `identifier_namespace` consumer in application,
+domain and SQLite adapters. Within that scanned source, the remaining explicit
+native-Parent **registration** requirement is the Exchange dependency loop; the
+parent-first import ranking and stripped Resource export/import reinforce it.
+The acquisition helper's old name is misleading but its current body does not
+register a Parent. It instead needs declaration propagation for new references.
+Do not restore hierarchy inference to solve missing identification.
+
+The following are intentional typed dependencies, not universal registration
+prerequisites: known plural child list ownership checks in `_members` and
+`validate_context_bindings`; explicit `inherit_fields(parent,child)` needing its
+actual operands; semantic Parent report referent checks; and native-I7/full
+Parent-report dependencies for **Transfer**. Use identification declarations for
+known native scope checks and resource_relations for actual Parent facts. Queries
+may expose identifier namespace coordinates without claiming a Parent report.
+The scoped parser/Timeline Event native checker remains for its known contract,
+not arbitrary Resource graph traversal. Re-run the callsite scan at each frozen
+implementation boundary; additions must be classified, not excluded by prefix.
+
+## Manageable implementation PRs and stable interfaces
+
+All branches below are proposals, require separate implementation authorization,
+and must be pinned to reviewed exact commits when created. D6 is documentation
+only. Reviews are separate non-Author freezes, not the Author reviewing itself.
+
+```mermaid
+graph TD
+  P133["#133 tooling f16e5b1"] --> D6["D6 design Author freeze"]
+  D6 --> RD["Non-Author design review"]
+  RD --> A["I6-A secure domain/admission"]
+  A --> RA["Non-Author A review"]
+  RA --> B["I6-B v5 identification/relations/collections codec"]
+  B --> RB["Non-Author B review"]
+  RB --> C["I6-C Provider and selective Exchange routes"]
+  C --> RC["Non-Author C end-to-end review"]
+  RC --> I7["I7 recovery / G-R1 / pairing"]
+  RB --> Q["I8 basic generic reads"]
+  I7 --> I8["I8 Transfer query / Search integration"]
+  Q --> I8
+  I8 --> G["Independent integrated / artifacts / regression gate"]
+  G --> F["Separately authorized both-fence retirement"]
+```
+
+**I6-A — `impl/adr0031-i6a-secure-admission`.** Depends on reviewed D6 and
+unchanged I4/I5 product ancestry. Files: `domain/p1_context.py`,
+`domain/parent_report.py`, `domain/production_context.py`,
+`domain/transfer_sql.py`, `domain/resource_stage.py`, proposed
+`domain/context_admission.py` and
+`domain/ports/context_authorization.py`, `adapters/sqlite/p1_context.py`,
+`adapters/sqlite/production_context.py`; update affected call signatures only in
+`application/acquisition.py` / `application/exchange.py` to keep them fail closed
+until C. If declaration/projection guards need extension, change only existing
+`adapters/sqlite/p1_ddl/context.sql`, `p1_schema.py` registration/verification and
+`p1_ddl/fingerprints.json` together, retaining native-I7/full-report FKs and both
+fences. No new domain table. New tests proposed under
+`tests/unit/test_context_admission.py`, plus existing
+`tests/integration/p3/test_transfer_admission.py` and `test_transfer_sql.py`.
+
+Public contract: mandatory originals and declarations; immutable complete types;
+mandatory AdmissionContext; pure `dependencies(unit)` / `validate_originals(unit)`
+separated from authorized current snapshot checks. Refusal codes R12 are stable.
+Test focus T02–09/13/17–20/26/27 and all inherited 29 I5/217 I4 obligations, without
+count-only acceptance. Evidence: independent reproductions of A1/B1/C1, SQL trace
+rollback, both-fence state, deny-all store/facade and replay, distributions with
+actual installed origins, explicit normal stage refusal. Freeze A for non-Author
+review before B relies on it; material corrections get re-review.
+
+**I6-B — `impl/adr0031-i6b-generalized-wire`.** Stack on accepted A review freeze.
+Files: `domain/resource_identification.py`, `resource_identity.py` only if a real
+codec defect is demonstrated, `production_context.py`, `selective_exchange.py`,
+`exchange.py`, `exchange_rows.py`, proposed `domain/context_wire.py`; unit tests
+proposed `tests/unit/test_context_wire_v5.py` and focused additions to
+`tests/integration/i3/test_selective_exchange.py`. Normal application wire routes
+remain fenced until C connects the complete codec; Transfer stays fenced.
+
+Public contract: exact v5 row/envelope schemas R02–09; named identification
+roundtrip; pure bounded `decode_context_v5` / `encode_context_v5` and
+`plan_context_dependencies` returning whole semantic units and typed omissions,
+never an authorization grant. Collections/Source/Coverage use existing authorities
+and real terminal APIs. Test focus T01–06/10–13/18/24/27 plus malformed versions,
+all explicit vectors, cap boundaries and ordering. Evidence: exact JSON bytes,
+digest recomputation, source/installed codec origins, stage refusal, independent
+non-Author protocol review/counterexamples at frozen B. SQL schema changes are
+not a prerequisite merely to transport the existing identification columns.
+
+**I6-C — `impl/adr0031-i6c-provider-selective-exchange`.** Stack on accepted B
+review freeze. Files: `application/acquisition.py`, `application/exchange.py`,
+`domain/acquisition.py`, `domain/ports/acquisition.py`,
+`adapters/github/production_intake.py` (including `NormalizedContextUnit` and
+`normalize_timeline_event`), `domain/selective_exchange.py`,
+`adapters/sqlite/production_context.py`, and composition-root/CLI callers that
+construct AdmissionContext (locate all callsites; no blanket exemption).
+Proposed tests `tests/integration/i6/test_wire_routes.py`, plus existing
+`tests/integration/i2/test_provider_intake.py`,
+`i23/test_provider_exchange.py`, `i3/test_selective_exchange.py`,
+`p5/test_provider_acquisition.py`, `p5/test_exchange.py`, and packaging probes.
+
+Public contract: every route uses A's same mandatory boundary and B's same codec;
+normalized Provider units carry original Parent observation and pre-filter endpoint
+declaration; selection planner and dependency checks share semantic-unit keys;
+package/row replay revalidates current authority. Read all seven Resource columns
+and both Event reference fields; no native Parent registration loop. Test focus
+T02–16/24–27, partial GraphQL/REST normalization, late/reverse/onward delivery,
+source current positives and actual whole-unit omissions. Evidence: independently
+executed sender→wire→receiver cases under an explicit synthetic isolated harness,

+# ADR 0031 I6 canonical vectors and adversarial test plan
+
+Companion to the [normative contract](adr0031-i6-wire-admission-exchange.md).
+These are design specifications; none is presented as new product execution.
+Synthetic fixture values below do not claim an actual Provider observation.
+Stable V/T IDs must appear in later implementation and independent receipts.
+
+## Canonical input vectors
+
+`J` means the exact Context canonical encoder from R03, not an arbitrary JSON
+serializer. JSON blocks showing rows are outer JSON; strings ending `_json` or
+containing identity TEXT have the literal escaped inner representation shown.
+Whitespace in these outer examples is for reading; hash the canonical dictionary
+under R03. Do not replace inner canonical strings with decoded values.
+
+**V01 — Global Document, no Parent dependency.** Register the Provider and this
+row; no namespace Resource or Parent report is supplied or required:
+
+```json
+{
+  "service_instance_uuidv4": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
+  "resource_kind": "document",
+  "provider_resource_id": "\"D\"",
+  "identifier_namespace_kind": null,
+  "identifier_namespace_id": null,
+  "document_kind": null,
+  "provider_document_id": "\"D\""
+}
+```
+
+**V02 — Scoped Event, namespace Resource absent.** This identity is independently
+complete and valid for Resource registration. It does not create an I7 Parent
+report or permit Transfer:
+
+```json
+{
+  "service_instance_uuidv4": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
+  "resource_kind": "comment",
+  "provider_resource_id": "[\"issue\",\"\\\"I7\\\"\",\"timeline_event\",\"E\"]",
+  "identifier_namespace_kind": "issue",
+  "identifier_namespace_id": "\"I7\"",
+  "document_kind": "timeline_event",
+  "provider_document_id": "\"E\""
+}
+```
+
+**V03 — Original Parent row.** After independently registering I7, this complete
+report can support V02's Event. It has clock 50, observation 51 and provenance P:
+
+```json
+{
+  "service_instance_uuidv4": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
+  "resource_kind": "comment",
+  "provider_resource_id": "[\"issue\",\"\\\"I7\\\"\",\"timeline_event\",\"E\"]",
+  "relation_kind": "parent",
+  "members_json": "[[\"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111\",\"issue\",\"\\\"I7\\\"\"]]",
+  "provenance_json": "{\"evidence\":\"P\",\"source\":\"fixture-provider\"}",
+  "scope_json": "{\"clock\":{\"at_us\":50,\"domain\":\"provider\"},\"document_kind\":\"timeline_event\",\"state\":\"complete\"}",
+  "observed_at_us": 51
+}
+```
+
+**V04 — Genuine one-sided explicit-NULL Event.** This exact decoded scope is
+canonicalized to `scope_json` on an Event report with Event clock 100,
+observation 101, provenance `{"evidence":"E","source":"fixture-provider"}`,
+`members_json="[]"`. Its EventReportKey is independent of V03's clock/provenance.
+The scope's three Parent strings quote V03 exactly:
+
+```json
+{
+  "clock": {"at_us": 100, "domain": "provider"},
+  "endpoints": [["transfer_to_repository", "null"]],
+  "event_type": "transferred",
+  "from_provider_repository_id": null,
+  "parent_members_json": "[[\"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111\",\"issue\",\"\\\"I7\\\"\"]]",
+  "parent_provenance_json": "{\"evidence\":\"P\",\"source\":\"fixture-provider\"}",
+  "parent_scope_json": "{\"clock\":{\"at_us\":50,\"domain\":\"provider\"},\"document_kind\":\"timeline_event\",\"state\":\"complete\"}",
+  "provided_roles": ["transfer_to_repository"],
+  "to_provider_repository_id": null
+}
+```
+
+Its sole endpoint row has V02's triple, `relation_kind=transfer_to_repository`,
+`clock_json=J({"at_us":100,"domain":"provider"})`, `target_json="null"`,
+the same original Event provenance and time 101,
+`event_report_members_json="[]"`, and `event_report_scope_json=J(the exact block)`.
+No from endpoint exists. The synthetic adapter must explicitly establish the
+original one-sided declaration; row absence alone never supplies that evidence.
+In normal I6 product connections this still returns the Transfer-stage refusal;
+positive admission is executable only in the isolated lane until R19 passes.
+
+**V05 — Two-sided explicit-NULL report and its truncation.** Starting with V04,
+set `provided_roles` to
+`["transfer_from_repository","transfer_to_repository"]` and `endpoints` to
+`[["transfer_from_repository","null"],["transfer_to_repository","null"]]`.
+Supply both endpoint rows bound to that new exact scope. This is a complete
+synthetic two-sided report. Supply only the to row with that declaration and
+expect `INCOMPLETE_ENDPOINT_SET`, zero Event/endpoint writes. Repeated/reversed
+transport of individual rows must not accumulate a pending report. The full
+original unit must be explicitly resupplied. This and V04 use separate disposable
+databases, or a genuinely different synthetic Event: changing the scope under
+V04's already admitted EventReportKey is an immutable replay conflict.
+
+**V06 — Provider-only unresolved mapping.** Starting with V04, set
+`provided_roles=["transfer_to_repository"]`, `to_provider_repository_id="\"R\""`,
+`endpoints=[]`, and `members_json` to
+`[["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","repository","\"R\""]]` encoded with J.
+Register the actual Provider repository Resource R. There are no translated
+endpoint rows. Preserve this attributed report with unresolved Provider state;
+no resolved Core Repository effect or explicit NULL follows. A later mapping
+does not update this report or automatically replay an earlier refused unit.
+
+**V07 — Resolved mapping, complete direct keys.** For an independently supplied
+synthetic resolved report, use Provider repository R and Core Repository
+`22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222`. The exact MappingClaimKey dictionary is:
+
+```json
+{
+  "service_instance_uuidv4": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
+  "resource_kind": "repository",
+  "provider_resource_id": "\"R\"",
+  "relation_kind": "represents_repository",
+  "clock_json": "{\"at_us\":80,\"domain\":\"provider\"}",
+  "target_json": "\"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222\"",
+  "provenance_json": "{\"evidence\":\"M\",\"source\":\"fixture-provider\"}"
+}
+```
+
+MappingSupport is the existing exact
+`{"provider_repository_id":"\"R\"","supporting_claims":[the dictionary]}`
+profile. Build original Event provenance using
+`encode_transfer_supported_provenance("fixture-provider","E",
+[("transfer_to_repository",support)])`. Explicitly declare the to endpoint's
+canonical UUID target string before filtering; all endpoint rows use that exact
+Event provenance/scope/time. This is a deterministic fixture construction, not
+permission to mint production provenance on replay. Admission must re-evaluate
+the same support's current eligibility. Missing claim is `MISSING_DEPENDENCY`;
+unqualified supplied support is `UNQUALIFIED_MAPPING`; an unauthorized target is
+`PERMISSION_DENIED`. None becomes explicit NULL or V06.
+
+**V08 — Concrete invalid mutations.** Apply each independently to a fresh
+fixture; rechecksum the outer package where appropriate. Expected unit writes
+are zero. Independent valid child identities can remain admitted under U4=B.
+
+| Mutation | Required result |
+| --- | --- |
+| V01 omits `provider_document_id`, or sets it NULL | Missing/incomplete identification; not a global Document |
+| V02 changes namespace ID to `"\"I8\""` without changing Resource ID | Reject native reconstruction mismatch |
+| V02 uses decoded nested `issue` namespace identity instead of canonical TEXT string | Reject wrong scoped profile |
+| V01/V02 stores raw `D`, numeric `7`, `true`, `null`, `[1]` or `{}` as canonical ID | Reject; never stringify |
+| ID text ` "D" `, `"\u0044"`, raw non-ASCII `"é"` | Reject noncanonical text; decoded scalar U+00E9 encodes as `"\u00e9"` |
+| Change kind to an unknown name only after failing a known-contract validation | Reject dispatch downgrade; no opaque retry |
+| Omit any V04 `parent_*_json`, or use NULL | `INCOMPLETE_ORIGINAL_REPORT`; no Event-based values |
+| V04 quotes Parent clock 100 / provenance E while only V03 exists | `MISSING_DEPENDENCY` for that exact different key; do not borrow V03 |
+| V03 member I8, quoted exactly by Event while native namespace remains I7 | Lawful attributed Parent retained; `QS10_PARENT_INELIGIBLE` for Transfer, including direct SQL bypass |
+| Omit V04 `endpoints` or pass constructor `endpoints=None` | `INCOMPLETE_ORIGINAL_REPORT`; no construction from surviving rows |
+| V04 endpoint `target_json` is JSON NULL instead of string `"null"` | Reject input type; explicit NULL is canonical target text |
+| V05 drops one endpoint row but keeps original scope | `INCOMPLETE_ENDPOINT_SET` regardless of stored endpoint rows |
+| V05 filters from role and rewrites `provided_roles`/`endpoints` | Sender contract violation; same EventReportKey conflicts if prior original exists; receiver cannot authenticate a coherent first-delivery forgery |
+| V07 declares target but removes supporting claim / substitutes a different target claim | Missing/invalid support; no locally recomputed replacement |
+| Set any nullable observation time to `true`, `1.0`, `"101"`, 0, -1 or int64-max+1 | Reject before SQLite affinity; NULL is valid only for nullable times |
+| Set Event clock `at_us` to NULL | Reject Transfer's required positive Event clock; general nullable-clock contracts are unchanged |
+| Add sender top-level `verified:true` or unknown row field | Reject exact envelope; a verified flag inside permitted attributed evidence is never authority |
+| Set `format` to v4, v6, empty, NULL, or omit it | `UNSUPPORTED_WIRE_VERSION`; no fallback |
+| Duplicate an outer/inner object key, malformed UTF-8, lone surrogate, NaN/Infinity | Reject strict parse before writes |
+| Same PackageKey with changed original or filtered content | Package content-binding conflict; new content needs new package ID |
+
+**V09 — Generic order and real terminals.** Owner V01 may own a new Document
+child and an unknown-kind Resource `x-widget` whose ID is `["p",[]]`; the Provider
+adapter must establish those synthetic native contracts. A generic relation
+`links` with members `[child,x-widget]` is distinct from `[x-widget,child]`.
+No semantic Parent is inferred from `links` or identifier components.
+For Collection kind `related`, provenance `{"source":"fixture","evidence":"C"}`
+and scope `{}`, these are four distinct inputs:
+
+| Time / state / members | Meaning |
+| --- | --- |
+| No row | No terminal, no completeness |
+| 200 / `complete` / `[]` | Genuine known-empty terminal |
+| 201 / `partial` / `[]` | Genuine partial terminal, not known empty |
+| 202 / `unknown` / `[child]` | Real observation with unknown completeness |
+| 203 / `complete` / `[child,x-widget]` | Complete ordered membership |
+
+At 204 send partial `[child]`; current Coverage cannot fall back to the complete
+203 report. At 205 supply both complete order alternatives; retain conflict.
+Selecting only child withholds the original two-member terminal and associated
+Coverage; it never exports `complete [child]`. Required terminal times cannot be
+NULL. Duplicate members are invalid. Same header/provenance with changed scope
+is an immutable conflict. Partial Source inventory `{R1}` must leave a previously
+known positive `{Source,R2}` intact.

+Status: **Design Author freeze for separate non-Author review; implementation
+not performed or accepted.** Task D6, 2026-10-22 UTC. This is an implementation
+contract under accepted ADR 0031, not a new ADR or an amendment to an accepted
+decision. Transfer remains refused by both SQL fences and ordinary routes.

+[source map, implementation graph and review handoff](adr0031-i6-change-map-and-handoff.md).
+Requirement IDs below are stable across I6-A/B/C.

+**R01 — Invariants.** `resource_relations` remains the sole semantic Parent
+authority. No new Parent table/header, writable duplicate Parent, winner,
+Mapping Witness, Publication, pending original-bearing queue, surrogate key,
+API archive, compatibility shim or real-data migration. A complete child can be
+registered before its namespace Resource or any Parent report. Native
+identification metadata does not assert semantic Parent existence. Native-I7
+typed SQL enforcement remains additional to complete Parent/Event report FKs.
+Identity parsing may check a known native contract; it must never infer a report.
